body: You own C36. research/TASK_C36.md is self-contained - read it and nothing else. R53 is running in the SAME checkout at the same time and owns ProfileRevampPanel.gd and GameState.gd; you own OfficeHubPanel.gd and its tests. Do not open the other two, and do not add a belt field to the retirement record - that would mean editing GameState.gd, which is mine this week. The trap: a retired fighter is off the roster and lives in the world population, so get_athlete() will not find them - route by athlete_id via GameState.gd:689 get_world_athlete_by_id and let the profile resolve it.
